name: Warm Japandi for three generations
summary: A calm, warm flat with a glass kitchen for daily cooking, a quiet room for Mdm Lim near the bathroom, and a family living and dining room with storage by the door.

style.name: Warm Japandi
style.mood: Pale oak, warm white walls and soft sage, with charcoal accents and clean low lines.

rooms.name: Master bedroom
rooms.intent: Mei Ling and Kevin's room: a queen bed, a full-height wardrobe and bedside tables.

rooms.name: Mdm Lim's room
rooms.intent: A super single bed, a built-in wardrobe and an armchair, close to Bath/WC 2.

rooms.name: Living and dining
rooms.intent: Sofa under the window facing a fluted feature wall, dining for four by the door.

rooms.name: Dry kitchen
rooms.intent: The fridge and a pantry corner, open to the dining.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.intent: Sink, hob and washer behind the new glass partition.

reasons: The glass kitchen keeps cooking smells in but lets light through.
Mdm Lim's room is beside Bath/WC 2 with a 0.90 m door.
Storage at the door keeps shoes and school bags out of the living room.
notes: Opening the shelter wall isn't something HDB allows; the living room stays as it is there.
